name: zakat-stickman-video
description: ZAKAT – Jangan Lupa Tanggungjawab Kita: minimalist stickman TikTok animation (Remotion)

scripts.render: remotion render ZakatVideo out/zakat-raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 && bash scripts/master.sh out/zakat-raw.mp4 out/zakat-tiktok.mp4
scripts.render:outro: remotion render ZakatVideoWithOutro out/zakat-outro-raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 && bash scripts/master.sh out/zakat-outro-raw.mp4 out/zakat-tiktok-dengan-outro.mp4 70
